_notes: Source: the Town Clerk's "Results of elections" sheet, supplied 2026-08-28 in answer to the owner's public-records request, covering 2022-2026. IT IS A WINNER-AND-COUNT LIST FOR THE PRINCIPAL TOWN OFFICES, NOT A RETURN: it carries no blanks, no write-in totals and no ballot questions, and it omits the School Committee in both years where an independent source shows one was elected (2023, per the Berkshire Eagle; 2026, per the town's own caucus notice nominating Jen Welch). The ballot figure is therefore a CEILING and no race can be closed against it. Election date 2025-05-27 established from the town's post of 2025-04-16, "important upcoming town events": "ANNUAL TOWN ELECTION Tues. May 27 2-4 and 6-8 pm at the town hall". SCHOOL COMMITTEE IS MISSING FROM THIS RECORD AND A SEAT WAS ALMOST CERTAINLY UP. The town's own posted ballots show a School Committee 3-year seat on the ballot in 2017 (Jen Welch, on write-ins), 2018 (Brenda Frye), 2019 (Lori Jayko) and 2021 (Frye again), and independent sources show one in 2023 (Eagle: Welch def. Scace) and 2026 (caucus notice: Jen Welch nominated). Three staggered three-year seats means one falls due EVERY year, so the office cannot legitimately vanish. The clerk's summary sheet simply does not carry it -- nor the Cemetery Committee, whose one-year terms are also up every year. This is NOT the 2021 restructure: that made the Town Clerk appointed (2021 ballot question, passed 44-36) and had already removed Tree Warden, Fire Warden and Library Trustee, but a School Committee is state-mandated and elected. See research/newashford_office_cycle.md.
